notes.title: Demo Version 0.966
notes.content: [h2]Major Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Emote selection added to the appearance menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Color selection added to the appearance menu.[/p][/*][*][p]New King of the Hill Map.[/p][/*][*][p]Players disconnecting or leaving a match will be replaced with bots.[/p][/*][*][p]New Powerup: C4.[/p][/*][*][p]Whack-A-Crate now has golden and explosive crates to watch out for.[/p][/*][*][p]Added advanced match settings including: Bot difficulty, hit power, movement speed, disable jump.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Minor Fixes and Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Improved bot behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could be eliminated twice in a row.[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra VFX to epic and legendary hats.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved player name rendering.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new emotes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where highlighted important players would not show while in rock form.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where powerups would not be removed on elimination.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved host start procedure.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Emote selection added to the appearance menu.
Color selection added to the appearance menu.
New King of the Hill Map.
Players disconnecting or leaving a match will be replaced with bots.
Whack-A-Crate now has golden and explosive crates to watch out for.
Added advanced match settings including: Bot difficulty, hit power, movement speed, disable jump.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where players could be eliminated twice in a row.

tags.feature: Added extra VFX to epic and legendary hats.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where highlighted important players would not show while in rock form.
Fixed a bug where powerups would not be removed on elimination.
